verses.text: “Come to me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might. Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall; but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, the LORD, make me live in safety.
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted amongst the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
And the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me. Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God. For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done. God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!” He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again. The LORD’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
The LORD, your God, is amongst you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
Not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord, rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer.
Strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy.
That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person.
It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labour and chasing after wind.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

messages.text: Come to Me, all you who are weary, and I will give you rest. Jesus is saying it to you.
Rest is holy. God Himself rested on the seventh day.
Jesus sat down tired by the well in Samaria. He understands weariness.
You do not have to do everything today. Do what you can and leave the rest with God.
Even Jesus told His disciples, Come away and rest a while.
Your worth is not measured by how much you get done.
Elijah was exhausted, and God gave him food and sleep before anything else. Take care of your body.
Those who wait on the Lord will renew their strength. Let Him refill you.
Say no to one thing today so you can say yes to rest.
A short prayer for tired days: Lord, be my strength.
The Lord gives sleep to His beloved. Go to bed in peace tonight.
Do not grow weary in doing good. In due season you will reap a harvest.
God never sleeps or slumbers, so you can.
You are allowed to be tired. You are human, and God made you to need rest.
Sunday is a gift. Rest, worship and enjoy the people you love.
Spend five quiet minutes before God with no agenda. Let Him restore your soul.
If you cannot pray for long, pray briefly. A tired heart's prayer is precious to God.
Mothers, fathers, carers and workers: God sees your hidden labour.
The joy of the Lord is your strength. Ask Him for a little joy today.
Take a walk, drink water, eat a good meal. Caring for yourself is part of caring for God's gift.
When everyone needs something from you, remember that you need God, and He is enough.
Saint Thérèse sometimes fell asleep during prayer. She said God loves little children when they sleep, just as when they are awake.
Let go of perfection. God asks for faithfulness, not flawlessness.
Christ's yoke is easy and His burden is light. Exchange your heavy load for His.
Be gentle with yourself. Even the strongest need rest.
God's grace is enough when your strength runs out.
Do one thing slowly and prayerfully today, and let it be enough.
Ask for help. You were never meant to carry everything alone.
My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest. That is God's promise.
Burnout is not a badge of honour. Rest is not laziness.
Offer your tiredness to God. Even weariness can become a prayer.
Sit in the sun for a while and let God warm your heart.
Pray before you sleep: Into Your hands, Lord, I commend my spirit.
Tomorrow, His mercies will be new. You can start fresh.
Jesus slept in the boat during the storm. Trust Him enough to rest.
Your energy is limited, but God's love is not.
Choose quiet over scrolling tonight. Let your mind rest in God.
God gives power to the faint and strength to the weak.
Saint Joseph worked hard and rested in God's will. Ask him to pray for you.
Better one handful with quietness than two hands full of toil.
You are a human being, not a human doing. God loves you for who you are.
Let Mary hold you like a weary child. She knows how to comfort.
When you feel empty, receive the Eucharist. Jesus is food for the journey.
Lay down your burdens at the foot of the Cross before you sleep.
Do not give up. Small steps still move you forward.
God will refresh the weary soul and satisfy the faint.
Delegate, simplify, slow down. Holiness grows in a peaceful heart.
Strength will come back. Seasons of weariness do not last forever.
Today, thank God for the strength He gave you to get this far.
Rest now. You have done enough for today, and God is pleased with your love.
